description: Full detail for ONE node: technical/business/security summaries, callers (who uses it), callees (what it calls). Pass a nodeId from resolve_context/find_symbols, or a symbol name to auto-locate. include=['code'] adds the raw source (first 120 lines; page with codeLines=[start,end]). Prefer this over reading whole files.

codeLines.description: With include:['code'] — absolute 1-based [start, end] file lines. Defaults to the first 120 lines of the node; max 400 per call. Follow the banner's next hint to page.

edgeTypes.description: Restrict callers/callees to these edge types

include.description: Default: summaries + callers + callees. Add 'code' for raw source.

node.description: nodeId, or a symbol/file name to locate first

name: get_node
